column1: # Margin: syscalls allowed although a learn run may not observe them. Each is on a rare or error path of the node or

column2: kernel-issued after a signal interrupts a restartable sleep (e.g. nanosleep); never called directly
return from any signal handler (SIGHUP/SIGTERM handling, logrotate's postrotate signal)
single-thread exit (glibc thread teardown); exit_group covers the process
abort()/raise(): assertion failure and fatal-signal paths, so the node still dumps a stack instead of EPERM
abort()/raise() pid lookup on the same path
lock backoff under contention (boost/std mutexes, NuDB); depends on load
database flush on rotation/online_delete; a short learn window may miss it
same as fdatasync for files opened without O_DSYNC (SQLite journal)
large realloc() growth of in-memory caches
